diagnosis_rule.implicated: I2 accuracy minus I0 accuracy is at least 0.25, I2 accuracy is at least 0.80, Oracle leakage audit passes, and I1 retains more similar-pair surface structure than I0
diagnosis_rule.inconclusive: all other outcomes or any missing condition
diagnosis_rule.not_implicated: I2 accuracy minus I0 accuracy is at most 0.05 with a passing Oracle leakage audit

downstream.checkpoint_rule: no training; deterministic frozen cosine decision

input_tracks.description: Local token, bigram, and character n-gram surface diagnostic
Explicit structured-event diagnostic upper bound, disabled by default

stop_conditions: official Belief-R test is read or used
Oracle input contains a forbidden or unknown field
a condition uses a different pair, label, threshold, seed, or downstream evaluator
